# dployr

Deployment platform. Hosted control plane + lightweight daemon (dployrd) on user-owned servers. Deploy via CLI, GitHub Actions, or web dashboard. No SSH, no inbound ports.

## Architecture

- Base: globally distributed control plane (hosted at dployr.io or self-hosted via dployr-base)
- dployrd: daemon on user's VM, maintains outbound mTLS WebSocket to Base
- All traffic routed Base -> dployrd, firewall stays closed

## Deployment

- Sources: public/private GitHub repositories
- Triggers: CLI, web dashboard, GitHub Actions (DPLOYR_TOKEN)
- Config: form builder (one-off) or blueprints (JSON/YAML/TOML, reusable, version-controllable)
- Zero-downtime: old version live until new one healthy
- Rollback: one click
- Next.js: auto-detected, no Dockerfile needed

## Runtimes

Officially supported: Node.js, Python, Go, PHP, Ruby, .NET, Java, Static.
Anything else: Docker runtime, bring your own image.

## Observability

- Real-time log streaming over WebSocket
- Browser console: interactive shell via dployrd tunnel, no SSH
- Process viewer: running processes and system stats
- File explorer: browse VM files from browser
- Resource graph: visual map of services and connections
- Events log: full audit trail, integrates with RBAC
- Watchdog: detects unresponsive/hanging/deadlocked services (not just crashes), notifies via Slack, Discord, email, or webhook

## Reliability

- Health checks per service: path, interval, failure threshold
- Auto-restart on failure
- Notifications on health threshold breach

## Networking

- Custom domains with automatic DNS verification and SSL provisioning (Caddy, auto-renewed)
- Reverse proxy built in

## Security

- mTLS on all agent-to-base traffic
- RBAC with full audit trail
- Secrets stored separately from env vars, never streamed to clients

## Pricing

- Hobby: free, 64MB RAM, 0.1 vCPU, 10GB disk, 1 workload, 2 custom domains per service (shared node, sleeps when idle)
- Indie: $12/mo (annual), 512MB RAM, 0.25 vCPU, 25GB disk, 5 workloads, 10 custom domains per service (shared always-on node)
- Pro: $20/mo (annual), 2GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 50GB disk, 25 workloads, 25 custom domains per service, dedicated instance
- Pricing model: per server, not per service or usage

## Key concepts

- Workload: one running service (API, worker, cron, etc.)
- Blueprint: declarative deployment config (runtime, source, build/run commands, env vars, secrets)
- dployrd: daemon on user's server
- Base: control plane, hosted or self-hosted
